methodology: Sequential fresh 30 MiB single-tab Windows QPA processes; native window pinned and active/exposed at validation points. Synthetic Qt inputs and completed QWidget paints; not physical input or DWM presentation. Normal/control pairs retain identical cadence, CSS and fonts. Control only blocks the disposable tab's recovery-draft timer signals. No concurrent builds/tests. First two pairs trace projection, layout and GUI work; final pair adds theme-signature, edit-context, inline-format-query and draft-I/O subscopes. Tracing adds overhead; this is diagnosis, not an optimization comparison. Inclusive scopes and nested Qt events must not be summed. Scope start is reconstructed from the logged elapsed time, with end sampled in the log handler. Trace thresholds: scopes >=0.1ms, Timer/MetaCall/Paint/UpdateRequest handlers >=1ms, heartbeat extra delay >=16ms; 16384 entries/phase. All timelines are untruncated. Nearest-rank quantiles; full per-operation data and timelines retained. One initial exploratory normal run is excluded because its scopes were less detailed. Working sets are process measurements, not heap sizes or guaranteed peaks.

runs.method: Native exposed MainWindow, standard app bindings, independent producer posts synthetic Qt keyboard/wheel/tab/action events at fixed cadence. Paint means completed QWidget paint dispatch, not DWM/display presentation. Nearest-rank quantiles; raw samples included. 8ms GUI heartbeat and 20ms working-set sampler. Isolated settings/files; autosave and update checks disabled; normal recovery-draft timers retained.
